title: My Next Tube 2
subtitle: React Native app
description: My Next Tube 2 is a React Native mobile app that provides real-time London Underground journey information using the Transport for London API. The app helps users quickly check station statuses, line disruptions, and service updates through a clean, intuitive mobile interface. Built from the ground up, it represents a full product development cycle including UX design, native mobile development, API integration, and App Store deployment. The project demonstrates my ability to take an idea from concept to a polished, production-ready application.

title: Volkswagen UK
subtitle: Automotive web apps
description: A suite of customer-facing web applications for Volkswagen UK, including Finance Calculator, Book a Service and Request a Test Drive. Built with React and TypeScript, with content managed through Storyblok CMS. Played a key role in migrating Volkswagen's frontend applications from Polymer to React and implementing the Feature Hub micro-frontend architecture, helping modernise the platform and improve maintainability.

title: SEAT Cars UK
subtitle: Automotive web apps
description: A series of web applications for SEAT UK, including the Finance Calculator and Request a Test Drive. Built with React and TypeScript, configured through Jahia CMS, and integrated with Volkswagen APIs. As the lead frontend developer on the account, I maintained and extended both applications while introducing Cypress end-to-end testing to improve quality and deployment confidence.

title: Skoda UK
subtitle: Automotive web apps
description: Maintained and enhanced the Škoda UK Book a Service application, built with React and TypeScript and configured through Storyblok CMS. Working as the lead frontend developer alongside backend engineers and QA specialists, I delivered new features, resolved defects, and ensured the application remained reliable and aligned with evolving business requirements.

title: VIA Outlets
subtitle: European fashion outlet
description: Maintained and enhanced the VIA Outlets web platform, supporting 11 outlet destinations across 9 European countries. Developed new features for the Fashion Club member area and built reusable React components integrated with Storyblok CMS, enabling content editors to manage multilingual sites independently. Contributed to the ongoing maintenance and improvement of multiple localised websites.

title: Wren Kitchens
subtitle: Kitchen showrooms
description: Created a promotional microsite for Wren Kitchens’ new Levittown, New York showroom using vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Responsible for the full frontend implementation, delivering a responsive and engaging experience to support the showroom launch. The project involved close collaboration with the marketing team to ensure the microsite aligned with brand guidelines and effectively showcased the new showroom.
